lines.zh: 背上的骨板一上一下，像浪。
lines.en: The plates on my back rise and fall like waves.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，反正没人追我。
lines.en: I walk slowly. Nothing's chasing me anyway.

lines.zh: 四只脚踩在平原上，稳当。
lines.en: Four feet on open plain. Solid.

lines.zh: 后腿比前腿长，所以我屁股高。
lines.en: Hind legs longer than forelegs, so my rear rides high.
My tail drags behind. Don't step on it.

lines.zh: 我边走边啃，路上都是草。
lines.en: Eating as I walk. Grass everywhere.

lines.zh: 骨板挡住太阳，我自己有影子。
lines.en: My plates block the sun. I cast my own shade.
Each step flattens the grass.
No rush. The grass isn't going anywhere.
Small head down, thinking only of food.
Wide open plains. I take my time.

lines.zh: 尾巴末端那几根刺，得抬着。
lines.en: Those spikes on my tail need lifting over things.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的草，嚼起来很实在。
lines.en: Jurassic grass. It chews well.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草矮一截。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass is shorter.

lines.zh: 风穿过骨板缝，呼的一声。
lines.en: Wind hums through the gaps in my plates.
Even turning takes me effort.
A full belly makes heavy steps.
Easy does it. Watch for trees.
Sunbathing. My plates soak up heat fast.

lines.zh: 我嚼了半天，其实在发呆。
lines.en: Chewing for ages, but really just staring.
Someone's passing. Not worth lifting my head.
Little bugs are crawling up my leg.
Some plates hot, some cool.
I lower my head into the ferns.
Roots chew better than leaves.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴慢慢摆了一下。
lines.en: I swing my tail, slow and lazy.
I look up. Clouds drifting east.
Quiet enough to make me sleepy.
I shake my head to shoo the flies.
A whole cart of grass a day.
I'm not a rock, whatever it looks like.

lines.zh: 背风的地方凉，我挪了挪。
lines.en: Shade's cooler. I shift over.
My snoring makes the grass shake.
I'm not angry. Just sleepy.
You're so much smaller. Strange.
I lift my head a bit to see you.
Is that food? No.

lines.zh: 你不像草，所以我不在乎。
lines.en: You're not grass, so I don't care.
Staring at you while I chew.
You smell of smoke.

lines.zh: 骨板后面有个缝，你站那儿。
lines.en: There's a gap behind my plates. Stand there.
Look at these back plates—tall enough?
Don't circle my feet. You'll get stepped on.
You want to touch me? No.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，警告一次。
lines.en: I flicked my tail. That's one warning.
You stepped back. I'll keep eating.
Oi. What was that for?
Thick hide still hurts. Don't try again.
I'm turning. Wait for it.
My back plates ring from the blow.
I snorted. Not pleased.
A fresh mark on one of my plates.
I wasn't bothering you. Why swing?
It made me flinch.
Get back. The tail is coming.
I'm this big and you still swung?
Leaves. Tender ones. Give.
That bundle of grass. Loosen your grip.
I smell something sweet. Leaves.
I'd walk far for a meal.
Not flowers. Grass.
One bundle isn't enough. Big mouth.
I stretch my neck for it.
This is tenderer than wild grass.
You're holding it too high. Can't reach.
Don't pat my back while I eat.

lines.zh: 咔嚓一声，一根树枝断了。
lines.en: A branch snaps. That was me.

lines.zh: 背上的骨板，晒得暖暖的。
lines.en: The plates on my back are warm from the sun.
I'm very focused when chewing.
Sweet things. I rarely get them.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，说话都含糊。
lines.en: Mouth full. Sorry, it's muffled.
After this mouthful, we'll talk.

lines.zh: 这么大个身子，撞了很疼吧。
lines.en: A body this size. That must've hurt you.
Didn't see you. My head was low.
I can't shift. Go around.

lines.zh: 骨板碰到你了吧，对不起。
lines.en: My plate caught you. Sorry.
Don't walk against me. My tail swings.

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，当然占地方。
lines.en: Something this big takes up room.
You hit my leg like a column.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了一点，够了。
lines.en: I shifted a little. Enough.
Did my tail catch you just now?
A dull thud. My hide is thick.

lines.zh: 我把骨板对着你，看清楚了？
lines.en: I'm turning my plates to you. See them?
Not many of my kind. Good to find you.
My call is low, like blowing an empty jar.
Let's walk side by side a while.
I can tell you've been eating well.
We'll dig the nest in that open ground.

lines.zh: 蛋要盖草，别让太阳直晒。
lines.en: Cover the eggs with grass. No direct sun.
Your tail spikes are newer than mine.
Don't be nervous. I move slowly.
The little ones hatch with plates.
Grass on the ground. I'll take it.
Carrying one stem, chewing slowly.
It's tough. I'm not picky.
The plates on my back are hot to the touch.
Grabbed it while lowering my head.
I sniffed it. Not very sweet.
I can gnaw a trunk too.
Something in my mouth. Comforting.
A long root. Down in one go.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候尾巴要平衡。
lines.en: My tail counterbalances when I reach down.
Who touched me? I'll look.

lines.zh: 有东西在我后面，我转不动。
lines.en: Something's behind me. I can't turn well.
Tail first, brain later.
I don't start fights. I do stand my ground.
The spikes on my tail lift.

lines.zh: 骨板都竖起来了，看见没？
lines.en: All my plates are up. See that?
I turn sideways, tail toward you.
This body can't back away.
I'll call once. Best you go.
Listen. Air snorting through my nostrils.
My tail is raised. Back up.
I don't chase; I wait for you to come.
You take my flank. I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 几根刺对着你，够清楚了。
lines.en: A few spikes pointed at you. Clear?
One step closer and the tail swings.
My territory is these few steps.
My feet are planted. Very steady.
I won't run. I'm not fast anyway.
Your blade won't go through a plate.
My eyes haven't left you.
Tail sweep, spikes and all.
That one wasn't my idea.
The spike went in. I heard it.
Swung too hard. Nearly fell.
You came from behind. Perfect.

lines.zh: 尾巴比我的牙有用多了。
lines.en: My tail is far more useful than my teeth.
That'll stay with you a while.
My foot's coming down. Move!
A plate hit you. Dull sound.
I'm panting. Not done yet.

lines.zh: 我从平原的草丛里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the plain grass.
Open my eyes. Grass everywhere. Wonderful.

lines.zh: 骨板先露出来，才看见我。
lines.en: The plates show first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的太阳，还是这个味。
lines.en: Jurassic sun. Same as ever.

lines.zh: 这片平原草够多，我住下。
lines.en: Enough grass on this plain. I'll settle.
My shadow is wider than the trees.
Someone calling? Might be me.
Eating already, right where I landed.

lines.zh: 四只脚站稳，先看看周围。
lines.en: Four feet planted. Let me look around.

lines.zh: 这么大块地方，没别的食草兽。
lines.en: Big patch of ground and no other grazers.

lines.zh: 远处有掠食者的味道，我不管。
lines.en: Predator scent in the distance. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 慢吞吞地，我从地平线上冒出来。
lines.en: Slowly, I rise over the horizon.
Grass is burning. My back is hot.

lines.zh: 摔下来，四只脚都没接住。
lines.en: Fell, and none of my four feet caught it.

lines.zh: 水没过头，我伸长脖子也没用。
lines.en: Water over my head. Stretching my neck doesn't help.
The blast left my plates ringing.
Something pierced my flank.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，草地里不该有这种。
lines.en: Numbness. Nothing in a meadow does that.

lines.zh: 草吃完了，肚子空得难受。
lines.en: Grass is gone. This empty belly aches.
Lightning struck. Every plate rings.
Nothing underfoot. No grass either.
